What is knowledge deflection?

The Knowledge deflection enables admin to view the list of knowledge base articles that are read and no incidents are created in a 24 hour time interval by a user. This configuration is available in the base system.

The knowledge base instrumentation also tracks the KB read pattern and the user pattern.

 

How would it reflect on dashboard?

The data is displayed on Self-Solved using Knowledge under Self-Solved percentage and on Self-solved KPI under Call Deflection percentage on the dashboard.

 

How you can customize it?

You can modify the following

  • Refresh window: The time to wait for incident creation before confirming a knowledge deflection
  • Knowledge bases considered for deflection
  • Users that this rule applies to (e.g. if you want to exclude your fulfillers, you can add this as a condition)

Alternatively, you can have your own method of measuring such deflections using SSA or any other instrumentation.
